definitions: To cause air to move over (something) by waving a fan or similar object.
To make (a fire or flames) burn more strongly by blowing air over them.
To spread out (something) in the shape of a fan.
To strike (a ball) with a bat or club but only hit air, missing the ball.
examples: She fanned herself with a magazine.
He fanned the flames with a piece of cardboard.
The cards were fanned out on the table.
The batter fanned on three pitches.
